take someone's pulse: Before the check-up, the nurse held my wrist to take my pulse, just as she does for every patient.
檢查前，護士握住我的手腕替我把脈，就像她對每位病人一樣。
feel the pulse of the city: Walk through the busy night market if you want to feel the pulse of the city after dark.
如果你想在入夜後感受城市脈動，就去熱鬧的夜市走一走。
pulse with energy: Every weekend the night market seems to pulse with energy, full of music, bright lights, and happy crowds.
每到週末，夜市似乎充滿活力，到處是音樂、明亮的燈光和開心的人群。
finger on the pulse: A good fashion designer always keeps a finger on the pulse of what young people want to wear.
一位好的服裝設計師總是掌握年輕人想穿什麼的動態。
pump money into: The government plans to pump money into the old train system so that trips become faster and safer.
政府計畫為老舊的鐵路系統注資，讓旅程變得更快、更安全。
pump iron: My brother goes to the gym every evening to pump iron because he wants bigger, stronger arms.
我哥哥每天傍晚都去健身房練舉重，因為他想要更粗壯有力的手臂。
pump someone for information: The reporter tried to pump the guard for information by buying him coffee and asking friendly questions.
那名記者請警衛喝咖啡、問些友善的問題，想向他套話。
pump up the volume: When our favorite song came on at the party, the DJ decided to pump up the volume and everyone started dancing.
派對上播到我們最愛的歌時，DJ決定加大音量，大家都開始跳舞。
pump up prices: Some sellers bought all the masks during the outbreak to pump up prices and make huge profits.
疫情爆發期間，有些賣家買光所有口罩來哄抬價格，賺取暴利。
adrenaline pumping: With my adrenaline pumping, I jumped out of the plane and felt the cold wind rush past my face.
我腎上腺素飆升，跳出飛機，感覺冷風從臉旁呼嘯而過。
punch a hole: Use this tool to punch a hole in each page before you put the papers into your binder.
把紙放進活頁夾之前，先用這個工具在每一頁上打洞。
punch in: Workers at the factory must punch in before eight o'clock, or they will lose part of their pay.
工廠的工人必須在八點前打卡上班，否則會被扣薪。
punch above one's weight: Our small school team likes to punch above its weight, and this year we even beat the national champions.
我們這支小學校的隊伍喜歡以小搏大，今年甚至擊敗了全國冠軍。
punch the numbers: The cashier had to punch the numbers into the old cash register by hand because the scanner was broken.
因為掃描器壞了，收銀員只好手動把數字輸入老舊的收銀機。
purchase a house: After saving money for ten years, the young couple was finally able to purchase a house near the beach.
存了十年的錢後，這對年輕夫妻終於能在海邊附近購屋。
purchase power: When prices rise faster than salaries, families slowly lose their purchase power and must buy less.
當物價上漲得比薪水快時，家庭就會逐漸失去購買力，只能少買一些。
purchase tickets online: To avoid the long lines at the station, you can purchase tickets online a week before your trip.
為了避免車站大排長龍，你可以在出發前一週網路購票。
get a purchase on: The climber could not get a purchase on the wet rock, so he slipped and grabbed the rope.
那位攀岩者無法在濕滑的岩石上抓牢，所以滑了一下，趕緊抓住繩索。
pursue a career: After graduating from college, Amy decided to pursue a career in nursing because she loves helping people.
大學畢業後，艾美決定從事護理職業，因為她喜歡幫助別人。
pursue a dream: He quit his office job and moved to Paris to pursue a dream of becoming a famous chef.
他辭掉辦公室工作搬到巴黎，去追成為知名主廚的夢想。
pursue a goal: If you pursue a goal with patience and hard work, you will reach it sooner or later.
如果你用耐心和努力追求目標，你遲早會達成它。
pursue the matter: The store refused to give her money back, so she hired a lawyer to pursue the matter in court.
那家店拒絕退錢給她，所以她請了律師在法庭上追究此事。
pursue a policy: For many years, the government has continued to pursue a policy of lowering taxes for small businesses.
多年來，政府一直持續推行為小型企業減稅的政策。
pursue a suspect: Two police officers on motorcycles had to pursue a suspect through the narrow streets of the old town.
兩名騎機車的警察必須穿越老城區的窄巷追捕嫌犯。
pursue studies: After working for two years, Kevin went to Canada to pursue studies in computer science.
工作兩年後，凱文前往加拿大繼續深造，攻讀電腦科學。
push for reform: Parents wrote hundreds of letters to lawmakers to push for reform of the school lunch program.
家長們寫了數百封信給立法委員，力促改革學校營養午餐計畫。
push one's luck: You already got the teacher to give you one extra day, so don't push your luck by asking for a week.
你已經讓老師多給你一天了，所以別得寸進尺，又要求延一週。
push the limits: Extreme athletes love to push the limits, trying more dangerous tricks every single year.
極限運動員喜歡挑戰極限，每年都嘗試更危險的特技。
push drugs: The police arrested a man who tried to push drugs to teenagers outside the school gate.
警方逮捕了一名在校門外試圖向青少年販毒的男子。
push someone around: Just because you are older doesn't give you the right to push your classmates around like that.
你年紀比較大，並不代表你有權那樣使喚你的同學。
push the boundaries: The young designer likes to push the boundaries of fashion by mixing traditional clothes with modern styles.
這位年輕設計師喜歡把傳統服飾和現代風格混搭，突破時尚的界線。
push ahead: Despite the heavy rain and strong wind, the builders decided to push ahead with the bridge project.
儘管下著大雨又颳強風，工人們仍決定推進橋樑工程。
